target_pattern: Use pronominal infinitives naturally inside high-frequency frames (tener que, querer, ir a, poder), selecting the correct reflexive pronoun and preserving body-part article patterns and required prepositions like quejarse de.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Treating the se part as optional or leaving pronouns in English-like positions.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: The reflexive pronoun must match subject and stay attached to the infinitive in these frame drills.
natural_examples: Vamos a banarnos antes de salir.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Tengo que acostarme temprano. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Tienes que levantarte a las seis. -> change subject to yo.
Base: Quiere despertarse tarde. -> change subject to ellos.
Base: Vamos a banarnos antes de cenar. -> change to singular yo.
Base: Puedo sentarme aqui. -> change subject to usted.
Base: Queremos lavarnos las manos. -> change to question with ustedes.
Base: Van a levantarse manana. -> change to hoy.
Base: Tiene que cepillarse los dientes. -> make it negative.
Base: Voy a lavarme la cara. -> change object to las manos.
Base: Quiero quejarme del ruido. -> change noun to trafico.
Base: Se queja de todo. -> change to nosotros.
Base: Nos quejamos del examen. -> change to ella.
Base: Podemos sentarnos aqui. -> change to singular yo question.
Base: Tienen que acostarse temprano. -> change to tu.
Base: Va a banarse. -> change to querer pattern with yo.

prompts: I have to get up early. (Tengo que levantarme temprano. vs Tengo que me levantar temprano.)
You want to sit here. (Quieres sentarte aqui. vs Quieres te sentar aqui.)
We are going to wash our hands. (Vamos a lavarnos las manos. vs Vamos a lavarnos nuestras manos as default pattern.)
Can I wash my face? (Puedo lavarme la cara? vs Puedo lavar me la cara?)
They have to brush their teeth. (Tienen que cepillarse los dientes. vs Tienen que cepillar se los dientes.)
I want to complain about the service. (Quiero quejarme del servicio. vs Quiero quejarme de el servicio.)
She complains about everything. (Se queja de todo. vs Queja de todo.)
We can sit down now. (Podemos sentarnos ahora. vs Podemos nos sentar ahora.)
You all are going to get up late. (Van a levantarse tarde. vs Van a se levantar tarde.)
I am going to wash my hands. (Voy a lavarme las manos. vs Voy a lavarme mis manos as neutral pattern.)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that you have to get up at 5:30 tomorrow.
Write that you want to sit near the window.
Write that your team is going to get up early for a trip.
Write that you can wash your hands before lunch.
Write that you have to brush your teeth after coffee.
Write that you are going to wash your face and leave.
Write that your coworker wants to take a shower after the gym.
Write that you ask if you can sit here for a minute.
Write that you want to complain about the internet service.
Write that your clients complain about the wait time.
Write that you complain about traffic every Monday.
Write that your friend is going to go to bed late tonight.
Write that you have to go to bed now because you are tired.
Write that you and your partner want to wake up earlier.
Write that your team can sit down after the presentation.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Dropping reflexive ending from infinitive chunk.
Missing contraction with de plus el.
Wrong pronoun placement in infinitive frame.
Mixing subject pronoun and reflexive form.
Not memorizing verb with its preposition.
